recognizedLightingDiagnostics.interpretation: A Lighting diagnostic also present before this trial. This establishes recurrence, not its cause, impact, or a production-script defect.

limits: Original content-log text, player/account names, paths, addresses, and unrelated messages are not copied.
A zero count for selected exception strings is not a general proof that no gameplay defect occurred.
The scanner does not classify every warning or verify resource rendering. Only the enumerated diagnostic signatures and severity markers were checked.
The known Lighting signature is retained as a diagnostic limitation; no configuration, resource, or game file was modified to suppress it.
